rule_or_requirement: Preserve valid completion while reducing lap time through pixel-only actions.
observable_information: HUD-derived speed and student posterior, plus valid finish, collision, progress and intervention traces on consumed TUNE cells.
allowed_action_or_state_change: At visual speed 54 or above, suppress only the student extra gas and retain the stable pixel driver's action.
expected_success_endpoint: At least 20 suppressed and 20 remaining extra-gas decisions, preserve the finish on 1:5200 and repair at least one prior student failure.
control: Frozen original pixel student checkpoint SHA-256 3c3cafc0d549c3777a6489ede397a4bd4f2390f8f2b1597ae6e0960dd4dc2194 without a visual speed ceiling.
falsifier: No meaningful suppression, loss of low-speed intervention, loss of the reference valid finish or no repaired failure.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Original and saturated student on three consumed TUNE cells 1:5200, 3:5201 and 2:5205, six episodes total.
resource_and_risk_gate: One registered Linux CPU diagnostic, 900 seconds and 2,000 decisions per episode; diagnostic only with no fresh promotion or external action.
